coverage_note:
Complete navigation coverage of the current canonical PR identifiers, plus explicit active-model obligations. Not an exhaustive extraction or proof of discharge of all paper/Lean antecedents. Branches are alternatives where stated; links do not alter claim-registry dependency roles.

**Governing search principle: find the simplest shared repair rule that satisfies the known constraints.** Reuse existing results before adding mechanisms. Geometry, reversible response and operational clocks require compatible maps from the same source process; separate component constructions do not establish that common realization.

groups.title: Common repair reference and law
groups.constructed: Finite conditional repair and candidate equalizers exist. Weighted averaging factors the supplied scalar stiffness exactly. A current-record lift couples native C to the existing six-level response at both seam endpoints, preserving its full load marginal and disjoint-seam locality.
groups.remaining: For the conditional-resampling branch, choose one state space, faithful reference and visible fibres. The conservative canonical extension and dissipative repair are different dynamics; a faithful thermal reference is not mandatory for every pure-state candidate. The full-model candidate must link its repair marginal, reversible port response and record clock through shared states and interventions; the scalar benchmark alone does not supply this. This lift adds local response factors and a supplied coupling, is one-way at the repair marginal, and does not establish the complete response grammar on the enlarged source.
groups.closure: Exhibit one local process and explicit restriction/intervention maps supplying the intended repair, carrier-response, reversible-current and clock contracts. Reuse the existing theorem implications once these interfaces hold; derive each extra choice or retain it as an explicit model hypothesis. Separate matched component fixtures do not establish a common source.

groups.title: Confluence, acceptance and protected observations

The endpoint-current lift inherits C/E completion by seamwise unitary conjugation; positive seam mixtures on its finite binary shell converge to their common fixed algebra after records are discarded, with protected local block populations.
groups.remaining: The required observer menu must supply completeness, local diamonds, well-founded aggregate descent, semantic read closure and valid acceptance. Mere agreement or oscillatory Hamiltonian evolution does not supply termination. This candidate fixed algebra is not identified with the full A2 observer equalizer; its absolute gap and refinement control have not been established.
groups.closure: Verify the complete contract on the actual operations and retained observations, including conflicting updates; do not infer it from translated-chart naturality.

groups.title: Inertia and the real dynamical completion
groups.constructed: Same-capacity linear reversible dynamics gives the displayed canonical Hamiltonian. Existing action-to-Hamiltonian and field-clock conversions remain proved under their own hypotheses. Three-mode curvature and an exact distance-two acceleration coefficient distinguish the I+epsilon A counterfamily after common clock/mass/speed calibration.
groups.remaining: Repair capacity equals inertia, velocity reading, linearity, energy and time reversal are candidate premises. Auxiliary oscillator and temporal Maxwell lifts are related alternatives, not consequences of the scalar construction.
groups.closure: Derive the kinetic identification from admissible operations or independently constrain dynamical response; exclude the same-equilibrium alternative inertias. Conversion of a supplied action is not its selection.

groups.title: Preparation of the same coupled vacuum
groups.constructed: For the original eight-mode q=3 action, the unchanged local gapped ramp has rigorous full-state error below 0.000433450 at model time 512 and 0.000108323 at 1024. At T=512, local time discretization with N=2^24 adds less than 0.000695044; a fixed d=8192 onsite code adds less than 0.000033144832 through all partial quadratic factors. The ideal finite preparation error is below 0.001162. Existing source controls compile that word with uniform synthesis error at most 1161/2^24; its preparation and subsequent history share one conditional mathematical budget in RE-10. The older finite-code preparation and its 0.059059008 bound remain a separate construction.
groups.remaining: Independent oscillator blanks, control of the ramp and model time are hypotheses. The native word has not been emitted or executed; physical pulse and code-service precision, storage, initialization and readout costs remain additional. Preparation is not autonomous vacuum selection; no uniform refinement resource theorem is supplied.
groups.closure: Implement the native preparation within the same-code history of RE-10 and charge actual initialization, pulse and service errors. Reuse the uniform synthesis estimate and transport the state-specific preparation error by channel contraction. Do not substitute q=3 evidence for q=5/q=233 budgets or a numerical trajectory for a certified bound.

groups.title: One encoded preparation, evolution and record history
groups.constructed: The original five q=3 force/retained-pointer histories and coupled-vacuum preparation compose on one d=8192 onsite code with 104 field and two pointer work qubits. Time, displaced occupation cutoffs and existing-source synthesis have a combined mathematical trace-distance bound below 0.001237, preserved by the same complete readout. All relative phases and outcomes are retained. The finite recipe has a conservative evolution pulse upper bound below 2^116, with fewer than 2^117 pack/export events; neither word emission nor native execution was performed.
groups.remaining: Physical blank/pointer initialization, pulse/control and coherent code-service accuracy, storage/drift, routing/reset, complete readback and their resource budgets remain supplied or unimplemented. The enormous constructive upper count does not establish efficient execution. Physical clock selection and refinement-uniform resources remain separate obligations.
groups.closure: Emit and execute an adequate native implementation and add reference-stable physical initialization, pulse, service, storage and readout errors to the constructed mathematical budget. Preserve complete records and the comparison order: uniform finite compiler on actual code, preparation error under a common extended finite history, state-specific ideal Gaussian history estimates, then complete readout. A common-code mathematical recipe does not close the physical experiment.

groups.title: Gauge algebra to physical gauge fields
groups.constructed: The finite local Standard Model Lie-algebra result remains proved under the adopted A1 complete-response/closure clauses and A2 endogenous transport. Compact-Lie classification is an explicit mathematics import.
groups.remaining: The physical current/action, same-source category, global form and coupling attachment remain separate. The scalar field construction does not instantiate a physical gauge theory. Compatibility with the twelve-port reversible response is an immediate law-selection constraint, even though constructing physical gauge fields is downstream. Scalar seam equalizers cannot serve as that current: their tested Lie closure is so(11), not the required twelve-dimensional algebra. Conserved difference drives in the endpoint-current lift omit the central relative-phase generator; the full twelve-direction response is a supplied interface, not derived physical gauge dynamics.
groups.closure: Bind the proved algebra and representation to actual source observables, dynamics and refinement; supply the categorical and physical gauge interfaces used by the selected branch.

groups.title: Common-model compatibility and remaining named inputs
groups.constructed: This crosswalk covers the canonical PR inventory and identifies actual scalar theorem reuse. The authoritative claim registry separately records ordinary assumptions, imports and explicit non-consumers.
groups.remaining: The whole paper/theorem body has not been exhaustively normalized into one semantic dependency graph. Ordinary assumptions and imported-result names are inventoried, not individually discharged by this crosswalk. The endpoint-current candidate declares twelve local six-level factors, conditional response operations, retained records and a coupling theta; its flat alternative shows that preservation and convergence alone do not select that coupling law.
groups.closure: For each promoted claim bind its actual assumptions and imports, all transitive antecedents and model-added hypotheses to compatible objects with scoped evidence. Keep unreviewed bindings visible and reject circular discharge.
